intro: Our London development is on the Isle of Dogs, 7 minutes on foot from Canary Wharf station.
about: Once purely a financial district, Canary Wharf has grown into a residential neighbourhood with parks, riverside walks, schools, and a retail centre.
It has strong amenity density with supermarkets, a growing restaurant scene, gyms, and green squares within a genuinely walkable estate.
The Elizabeth line made travelling to the West End and Heathrow quicker.

items.note: The first buildings, around Canada Square, with the easiest reach of the office.
The newest district in the estate, with buildings opening in phases from 2019.
A mix of established and newer towers just south of the estate.
Quieter, more residential Isle of Dogs streets, a short walk or DLR ride from the Wharf.
On the opposite side of the river, reachable by the Jubilee line and DLR.
